Class FastqWriter

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.exporters.FastqWriter
public final class FastqWriter extends Object
FASTQ exporter.

Writes a WrittenGenomicRun to a FASTQ file with optional gzip. Each read becomes a 4-line record:

  @read_name
  SEQUENCE
  +
  QUALITIES

Internal 0xFF "qualities unknown" sentinel bytes are mapped to Phred 0 (ASCII !) on output so the result is always a parseable FASTQ.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.exporters.fastq.FastqWriter, Objective-C TTIOFastqWriter.
